sql: WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), endpoints AS (SELECT 'customer_last' mode,customer_id,first_d,last_d end_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'global_last',customer_id,first_d,(SELECT MAX(d) FROM net) FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_month_end',customer_id,first_d,date(last_d,'start of month','+1 month','-1 day') FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'global_month_end',customer_id,first_d,(SELECT date(MAX(d),'start of month','+1 month','-1 day') FROM net) FROM bounds), spine(mode,customer_id,d,first_d,end_d) AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,first_d,first_d,end_d FROM endpoints UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,end_d FROM spine WHERE d<end_d), bal AS (SELECT s.*,SUM(COALESCE(n.net,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY s.mode,s.customer_id ORDER BY s.d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31 FROM bal), variants AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'30_at30' win,avg30 avg_balance FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at30',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at31',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=31), cm AS (SELECT mode,win,customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg_balance,0)) mx FROM variants WHERE date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY mode,win,customer_id,m) SELECT mode,win,m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(mx) total FROM cm GROUP BY mode,win,m ORDER BY mode,win,m
